1.w: The one sitting in the secret place of the Most High, in the shade of Shaddai he will abide.

2.w: I will say of YHWH: “My refuge and my stronghold, My God, I trust in Him!”

3.w: Surely He will snatch you from the snare of the trapper, from the plague of calamity.

4.w: With His pinions He will give cover for you, and under His wings you will take refuge; a shield and buckler [is] His faithfulness.

5.w: You shall not be afraid of the terror of the night, [or] of the arrow [that] flies by day,

6.w: from the plague that walks in the darkness, [or] from the pestilence that destroys at noon.

7.w: A thousand may fall at your side, and a multitude at your right hand—it shall not draw near to you.

8.w: But with your eyes you shall look, and you shall see the reward of the wicked.

9.w: Because You, O YHWH [are] my refuge; the Most High you have made your dwelling place.

10.w: Evil shall not meet with you, and plague shall not come near, by your tent.

11.w: For He will command His angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways.

12.w: Upon the hands they shall lift you up, lest you strike your foot against a stone.

13.w: Upon the lion and cobra you will tread; you will trample the young lion and the serpent.

14.w: “Because in Me he has delighted, so will I rescue him; I will set him up high because he has known My Name.

15.w: He will call on Me and I will answer him; I [am] with him in distress; I will deliver him and honor him.

16.w: With length of days I will satisfy him, and cause him to look on My salvation.”
